Fact: data_acquisition
What to find: How training data was obtained and selected, including annotation and synthetic-data generation methods and how rights were obtained.
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Collection

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card gives only partial information. Pre-training used a multimodal corpus of 45T tokens. Post-training data came from large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments, with progressive scaling of data, tasks, and rollouts. The card does not state how data rights were obtained or how annotation was done.
quotes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is trained from scratch on a multimodal corpus comprising **45T tokens**, with sparse attention trained at a sequence length of 64K and context extended to 1M tokens at 34T tokens.
All substantive changes lie instead in the data pipeline: large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments with progressive scaling of data, tasks, and rollouts.
